title: Sign in
hint: Players sign in from the game. Administrators can also sign in with the server’s admin key.
adminOnly: This page is restricted to administrators.
adminOnlyText: Your status is checked by the game server, not by the browser.
step1: Launch Eco and join the server
step2: In the game, open the menu and click the world website link.
step3: The game opens this panel with a temporary token: you are then signed in for 24 hours.
publicText: Without signing in, everything public stays available: map, statistics, ecology, economy and governance. Signing in lets you vote, comment and, for administrators, access the administration area.
keyText3: ). It grants administration rights on the panel: only share it with staff.
remember: Remember this device (30 days). Otherwise, until the tab is closed.
keyUnreachable: The server is not responding: the key cannot be checked right now.
